## Public-content review

- [ ] I inventoried every added or changed quantitative, comparative, customer,
      availability, pricing, and research statement.
- [ ] Each retained measurement links to an immutable artifact containing the
      workload, baseline, configuration, dimensions, tolerances, system boundary,
      raw observations, and source commit.
- [ ] Third-party research is clearly attributed and the linked source supports
      the exact adjacent wording.
- [ ] Product availability, licensing, support, and pricing match an offering a
      visitor can actually obtain.
- [ ] Customer outcomes are real, permissioned, and directly documented.
- [ ] `npm run check:content` and `npm run build` pass.
